en.text: No. It was precisely because she knew we had meant well that she would never believe us.
en.html: No. It was precisely because she knew we had meant well that she would never believe us.

ja.text:
稟
「なおくんの右手を奪い。さらに絵を奪い、お父さんを苦しめた」
ja.html:
稟
「なおくんの右手を奪い。さらに絵を奪い、お父さんを苦しめた」

en.text:
Rin
“I took your right hand. Then I took painting away from you. I made Father suffer.”
en.html:
Rin
“I took your right hand. Then I took painting away from you. I made Father suffer.”

ja.text:
稟
「全部私の弱さが招いた事なんだ」
ja.html:
稟
「全部私の弱さが招いた事なんだ」

en.text:
Rin
“All of it happened because I was weak.”
en.html:
Rin
“All of it happened because I was weak.”

ja.text:
稟
「私はお父さんを逆恨みしていた」
ja.html:
稟
「私はお父さんを逆恨みしていた」

en.text:
Rin
“I blamed Father for something that wasn’t his fault.”
en.html:
Rin
“I blamed Father for something that wasn’t his fault.”

ja.text:
稟
「お母さんを奪ったという嘘の記憶を作り出して……、
自分がお母さんを殺してしまった事実を受け入れられなかったから！」
ja.html:
稟
「お母さんを奪ったという嘘の記憶を作り出して……、
自分がお母さんを殺してしまった事実を受け入れられなかったから！」

en.text:
Rin
“I invented a memory in which Father stole Mother from me—all because I couldn’t accept that I was the one who killed her!”
en.html:
Rin
“I invented a memory in which Father stole Mother from me—all because I couldn’t accept that I was the one who killed her!”

ja.text: 稟は再び走り始める。

en.text: Rin begins to run again.
en.html: Rin begins to run again.

ja.text: 汗だくで、まるでもがくように、
ja.html: 汗だくで、まるでもがくように、

en.text: Drenched in sweat, as though fighting against an unseen current,
en.html: Drenched in sweat, as though fighting against an unseen current,

ja.text: ただ走り続ける。
ja.html: ただ走り続ける。

en.text: she simply runs on.
en.html: she simply runs on.

ja.text: もう二人に言葉は無かった。
ja.html: もう二人に言葉は無かった。

en.text: There are no more words between us.
en.html: There are no more words between us.

ja.text: 沈黙の中で、稟は走り、俺は彼女を追いかける。
ja.html: 沈黙の中で、稟は走り、俺は彼女を追いかける。

en.text: In silence, Rin runs and I follow.
en.html: In silence, Rin runs and I follow.

ja.text: そして、あの場所にたどり着いた。
